Prevalence-abundance and core-microbiome plots

Source: R/mp_stats.R
mp_prevalence.Rd

Summarises how widely each taxon is detected. plot.type = "scatter" plots prevalence against mean relative abundance (a standard QC / core-selection view); plot.type = "core" draws a core-microbiome heatmap of prevalence across a gradient of detection thresholds.

Usage

mp_prevalence(
  object,
  tax.level = NULL,
  plot.type = c("scatter", "core"),
  detection = 0.001,
  prevalence = 0.5,
  color.by = NULL,
  label.top = 10,
  palette = NULL,
  theme = NULL,
  ...,
  plot.title = NULL,
  plot.subtitle = NULL,
  plot.caption = NULL,
  font.size = getOption("micropubr.font.size", 11),
  interactive = FALSE,
  return.data = FALSE,
  verbose = getOption("micropubr.verbose", FALSE)
)

Arguments

object

A phyloseq::phyloseq object (counts).

tax.level

Optional rank to agglomerate to first.

plot.type

"scatter" or "core".

detection

Detection threshold (relative abundance) defining presence for the scatter plot's prevalence and the core threshold line.

prevalence

Prevalence threshold (fraction of samples) for the core line / core membership.

color.by

For "scatter", a taxonomy rank to colour points by.

label.top

Number of most-prevalent taxa to label (scatter).

palette, theme, plot.title, plot.subtitle, plot.caption, font.size

See mp_alpha().

...

Passed to the primary geom.

interactive

If TRUE, return an interactive plotly widget instead of a static ggplot (requires plotly). See mp_alpha().

return.data

If TRUE, return the prevalence/abundance table.

verbose

Print the methods used.

Value

A ggplot object, a plotly widget when interactive = TRUE, or a data frame when return.data = TRUE.
